title: Committed archive is a scripted credential-distribution path
impact: Any party with repository read access obtains nine working signed Power Automate URLs covering 11 of 19 contract keys, including every write-side contract.
remediation: Rotate all nine, untrack the archive, and source setup credentials from a secret store.

title: Live-shaped SAS signature committed in newack/config.js
impact: Possession of the committed signature authorises invoking the acknowledgement flow.
remediation: Rotate in Power Automate, then remove and read from runtime config.

title: 31 distinct signatures and an UNREDACTED manifest inside the tracked archive
impact: The archive is the single largest credential concentration in the repository and re-exposes signatures removed from the working tree.
remediation: Rotate all 31, then retain the archive outside version control.

title: Four distinct signatures recoverable from Git history
impact: Removal from the working tree revokes nothing; all four remain retrievable by any cloner.
remediation: Rotate first; history rewrite is secondary.

title: Authorization proxy is not in the request path; every RBAC control is bypassable
impact: No enforced authorization boundary exists in the shipped default configuration for any of the four trees.
remediation: Supply tenantId, clientId and proxyBaseUrl, set enabled true, and deploy proxy/.

title: ActivityHub route guard returns true unconditionally while auth is inert
impact: /admin, /audit and /directory open for any visitor in the default posture.
remediation: Evaluate ROUTE_ROLES in both postures and keep the server as the boundary.

title: newack/ renders API data into innerHTML with no escaping mechanism
impact: Script execution in the session of anyone viewing the acknowledgement dashboard, if the upstream flow returns markup.
remediation: Escape at the sink or build rows with textContent, and add a CSP.

title: Unpinned third-party script with no SRI and no CSP in the executive portal
impact: Compromise of unpkg or the lucide package yields arbitrary code execution in the DG/CEO portal session.
remediation: Pin an exact version and add SRI, or self-host, or add a script-src CSP.

title: No Subresource Integrity anywhere in the repository
impact: No external subresource is integrity-checked.
remediation: Add SRI to every external subresource, or self-host them.

title: ECM_ActivityHub_Portal/ and newack/ have no CSP or referrer policy
impact: Two trees have no browser-side content restriction of any kind.
remediation: Extend the same meta CSP; add edge headers for frame-ancestors.

title: Proxy idempotency is in-memory and unsafe under horizontal scaling
impact: Duplicate governed writes when a retried idempotency key lands on a second instance.
remediation: Back the store with Redis or a table before scaling out.

title: modules/comments.js renders a backend referenceId unescaped
impact: Backend-controlled reference text reaches innerHTML without escaping.
remediation: Wrap the interpolation in esc().

title: Missing runtime config degrades silently and indistinguishably
impact: A deployment that forgot its configuration renders identically to a working one.
remediation: Surface an explicit banner when zero endpoints resolve.

title: newack/ and document-portal/ are outside the import and link checks
impact: Two of four trees have their module graphs and links validated by nothing.
remediation: Add the missing entry points and make the link job gating.

title: ECM_ActivityHub_Portal/ is tested only at index.html
impact: 19 pages, 13 services and both routers are unexercised; this is why F-006 survived.
remediation: Add route-level smoke coverage and a canOpen() unit test.

title: newack/ has zero test coverage and is served by npm start
impact: An orphaned tree carrying a credential and an unescaped sink is served without any check.
remediation: Delete the tree, or bring it under test and into the import/link checks.

title: Secret ratchet permits known exposure indefinitely
impact: A green CI secret job is compatible with 32 unrotated signatures indefinitely.
remediation: Add a per-entry expiry date that fails the build once passed.

title: RBAC route model and proxy action model have drifted
impact: UX defect only: operator may open /dispatch and executive /archive, then be refused on submit. Both fail closed.
remediation: Derive one table from the other, or assert consistency in governance.test.mjs.

title: Proxy /healthz is unauthenticated and discloses contract-key names
impact: Unauthenticated disclosure of contract-key names and deployment completeness.
remediation: Return a bare ok unauthenticated and gate detail behind auth.

title: stripAssertedIdentity() does not strip below body.payload and is untested
impact: Deeply nested client-asserted identity survives forwarding; mitigated by the authoritative _identity injection.
remediation: Strip recursively and add a payload.data.role test case.

title: Unescaped values in operator-hud.js and reports.js
impact: A backend count value and a user-entered date reach innerHTML unescaped, the latter in attribute context.
remediation: Wrap both in esc().

title: Committed binary deliverables and an orphaned config module
impact: Repository hygiene; no evidenced path to impact.
remediation: Move deliverables out of source control; delete or wire the orphan.

title: DOC-DRIFT: stated rotation backlog understates measured exposure
impact: A rotation programme scoped to the documented 22 leaves at least nine signatures live.
remediation: Re-derive the figure from node tests/check-secrets.mjs and restate it.

title: DOC-DRIFT: credential exposure rated Low on an unverifiable premise
impact: The governing status document presents active credential exposure as a low-priority item.
remediation: Re-rate against the evidence, or record the environment separation that justifies pilot-only.
